evidence.title: Incident Report: Free-Zone Wire Transfer
evidence.content: Diplomatic courier Rashid Al-Suwaidi used his own credentials to authorize a large wire transfer through a Doha free-zone bank. He claims he was blackmailed into it.

evidence.title: Rashid Al-Suwaidi: Coerced Statement
evidence.content: "They had photos of my family. I was told exactly which account, exactly which day. I didn't ask questions. I've never even met the person who told me what to do — everything came through an intermediary."

evidence.title: Wire Memo Fragment
evidence.content: Transaction reference COR-1942-R reuses the COR-19 code family seen in Cases 001–003. Beneficiary account is administered by Ashcroft Maritime Security, listing itself as an "asset protection" contractor.

evidence.title: Ashcroft Maritime Security — Client Filing
evidence.content: Contract schedule lists "Corvid Systems Advisory" as a retained client for "field asset protection." First appearance of a private security contractor tied directly to Corvid.

evidence.title: Protection Referral — Requires Confirmation
evidence.content: HER STORY protective-referral document for Al-Suwaidi. This case's actual objective isn't convicting him — it's building the case against Ashcroft while keeping him off any public record that could expose him to retaliation.

chat.text: International capital, a private security contractor, and a diplomat scared enough to talk. Whoever's funding this has real money and real reach. I need to know who's paying.
I want this on record somewhere that isn't public. If Ashcroft finds out I talked, my family isn't safe.
There's a name people used once, off the record — 'the Underwriters.' Nobody explained it. I don't think it exists on paper anywhere.

solution.successMessage: Al-Suwaidi isn't the case. He's a man with a family and a threat hanging over both. Ashcroft is the case — the contractor that turned a diplomat's fear into a funding pipeline for Corvid. Submission protects him and names them.

onDocument.c6_ev04: Ashcroft. Private security, on retainer to Corvid. This has real money behind it now.

onThread.c6_thread02: 'The Underwriters.' First time that name's come up. Nobody's explained what it means. Worth remembering.

onFlag.COERCION_CONFIRMED: Protect him. That's the job here, not convict him.

onBookmark.c6_ev04: Bookmarked. Ashcroft Maritime Security — first named here, definitely not the last time.

narrativeBeats.onSubmitSuccess: Ashcroft's role goes on record. Al-Suwaidi doesn't. Renata flags the protective referral personally and says nothing else about it.
